title: Healthcare Digital Assurance Framework
description: Reusable gated assurance framework for healthcare digital services. It models clinical safety, privacy, security, service readiness and post-release monitoring as governance gates. Compliance regimes such as ASVS, NIST, ISO or local healthcare standards remain separate versioned rulesets and mapping packs.

assurance_profiles.title: Healthcare digital service
assurance_profiles.description: Default profile for patient, clinician or operational healthcare software.

assurance_profiles.title: Patient-facing service
assurance_profiles.description: Services used directly by patients, carers or members of the public.

assurance_profiles.title: Clinical workflow service
assurance_profiles.description: Services used by clinical staff or affecting clinical workflow, safety or decision making.

assurance_profiles.title: Operational healthcare service
assurance_profiles.description: Back-office, integration or operational services supporting healthcare delivery.

roles.title: Clinical Safety Officer
roles.description: Reviews clinical safety hazards, mitigations, residual clinical risk and clinical safety case evidence.
responsibilities: Confirms clinical hazard controls are testable

roles.title: Caldicott Guardian or Health Data Steward
roles.description: Confirms that patient-identifiable information use is justified, proportionate and governed.

roles.title: Data Protection Lead
roles.description: Reviews privacy, lawful basis, DPIA, retention and data-subject-rights evidence.
responsibilities: Confirms privacy controls and lawful basis

roles.title: Security Assurance Lead
roles.description: Reviews security design, vulnerability evidence, assurance tests and residual security risk.

roles.title: Clinical Product Owner
roles.description: Owns clinical workflow intent, user acceptance and patient/clinician outcome alignment.

roles.title: Service Owner
roles.description: Owns service readiness, operational impact and release decision accountability.

roles.title: Clinical Operations Lead
roles.description: Confirms operational workflow readiness, support model and clinical service impact.

roles.title: Supplier or Engineering Lead
roles.description: Provides implementation, test, deployment, remediation and release evidence.

roles.title: Healthcare Change Advisory Board
roles.description: Authorises release or live change after assurance evidence and residual risks have been reviewed.
responsibilities: Reviews release impact and rollback approach

roles.title: Patient or Service User Representative
roles.description: Represents patient or service-user usability, accessibility and communication concerns where applicable.
responsibilities: Confirms communication and accessibility concerns are considered

processes.title: Healthcare Assurance Path to Release
processes.description: End-to-end healthcare assurance path from initial scope through clinical safety, privacy, security, validation, release and live monitoring.
entry_conditions: A digital service handles healthcare data, supports healthcare operations or affects clinical workflow.
The project requires explicit clinical safety, privacy, security or operational assurance before release.

exit_outcomes.title: Healthcare release approved
exit_outcomes.description: Required clinical, privacy, security and operational evidence has been reviewed and release is approved.

exit_outcomes.title: Conditional healthcare release
exit_outcomes.description: Release is approved with explicit conditions, compensating controls, waivers or follow-up actions.

exit_outcomes.title: Healthcare release deferred
exit_outcomes.description: Release is deferred because required evidence, approvals or risk decisions are missing or unacceptable.

gates.title: Healthcare assurance intake
gates.description: Classify clinical, privacy, security and operational assurance scope before design or release commitments are made.

criteria.title: Healthcare service scope is classified
criteria.description: The service declares whether it is patient-facing, clinical-workflow, operational or integration-only, and records why.

criteria.title: Initial assurance obligations are declared
criteria.description: Clinical safety, privacy, security and operational assurance obligations are identified before blueprint/project FR selection.

gates.title: Clinical, privacy and security design assurance
gates.description: Confirm the design has reviewable clinical safety, data protection and security obligations before implementation proceeds.

criteria.title: Clinical hazards and mitigations are reviewable
criteria.description: Clinical hazards, mitigations and safety assumptions are recorded and linked to testable FR/TBT obligations where software behaviour is involved.

criteria.title: Privacy and patient data obligations are reviewable
criteria.description: DPIA, lawful basis, minimization, retention and confidentiality obligations are declared and mapped to FR/TBT or manual evidence where applicable.

criteria.title: Security assurance obligations are mapped
criteria.description: Security blueprint/project FRs and TBTs are selected for the service, including applicable ASVS/NIST/other ruleset mappings.

gates.title: Assurance test readiness
gates.description: Confirm that clinical, privacy, security and operational obligations have planned evidence before validation starts.

criteria.title: Required TBTs have evidence plans
criteria.description: Every accepted FR/TBT obligation has a planned test, manual artifact, waiver or compensating control before validation proceeds.

criteria.title: Test environments and synthetic data are safe
criteria.description: Test execution uses synthetic/disposable data or approved privacy-preserving fixtures, with no unnecessary patient-identifiable data exposure.

gates.title: Clinical and user validation
gates.description: Review observed clinical workflow, usability, accessibility, privacy and security evidence before release authority.

criteria.title: Clinical workflow validation is complete
criteria.description: Representative clinical users validate the workflow, known hazards and fallback behaviours, or record why this is not applicable.

criteria.title: Security and privacy evidence is observed
criteria.description: Required security/privacy TBTs and scanner evidence have been observed or formally dispositioned before release.

gates.title: Healthcare release authority
gates.description: Confirm release readiness, residual-risk acceptance, rollback and operational ownership before go-live.

criteria.title: Residual risks and exceptions are accepted
criteria.description: Open clinical, privacy, security and operational risks are either remediated or accepted by accountable roles with conditions recorded.

criteria.title: Deployment, rollback and support are ready
criteria.description: Deployment plan, rollback plan, monitoring and support routes are approved before release.

gates.title: Live monitoring and continual assurance
gates.description: Confirm monitoring, incident response, clinical safety review and evidence refresh after release.

criteria.title: Clinical and operational monitoring is active
criteria.description: Clinical safety signals, operational incidents, security alerts and privacy incidents have defined monitoring and escalation routes.

criteria.title: Assurance evidence refresh is scheduled
criteria.description: Security scans, TBT execution, clinical safety review and privacy review cadence are recorded for through-life assurance.

processes.title: Urgent Healthcare Safety Change
processes.description: Accelerated path for urgent changes needed to address patient safety, clinical continuity, privacy breach containment or active security risk.
entry_conditions: A change is required urgently to protect patient safety, clinical continuity, privacy or security.
Normal release cadence would introduce unacceptable healthcare risk.

exit_outcomes.title: Urgent change approved
exit_outcomes.description: Urgent change is approved with explicit residual-risk conditions and post-change review.

exit_outcomes.title: Urgent change rejected
exit_outcomes.description: Urgent change is rejected or returned to the standard assurance path.

gates.title: Urgent safety-change triage
gates.description: Confirm the urgent route is justified and define the minimum evidence required before change authority.

criteria.title: Urgent route justification is recorded
criteria.description: The reason for bypassing the standard path is documented with patient safety, privacy, security or continuity rationale.

gates.title: Urgent change authority
gates.description: Authorise or reject the urgent change with explicit minimum evidence, rollback and post-change review requirements.

criteria.title: Minimum safety and rollback evidence is accepted
criteria.description: The urgent change has enough evidence to proceed, a rollback plan and a named accountable residual-risk owner.

gates.title: Post-change assurance review
gates.description: Confirm the urgent change behaved as expected and capture any remediation or permanent assurance work.

criteria.title: Post-change outcomes and follow-up actions are recorded
criteria.description: Post-change monitoring, incidents, clinical safety outcomes, security evidence and follow-up actions are recorded.

process_links.label: Live safety/security signal may trigger urgent change
process_links.description: Operational monitoring can trigger the urgent safety-change path when patient safety, privacy, security or clinical continuity risk cannot wait for normal release cadence.

process_links.label: Post-change review informs continual assurance
process_links.description: Post-change outcomes and follow-up actions feed back into the live monitoring and continual assurance gate.
